params.load: 0..1 the 40 weight blocks drop onto the chips, chip by chip (5 per chip); at 16 bits 3 fit under the bar and 2 spill onto the red overflow pile
params.bits: 0..1 0 = 16 bits per weight (16.4 GB: tall blocks, 24 on the chips, 16 on the pile); 1 = ~4.5 bits (5.2 GB: blocks 0.32 as tall, the pile flies back, all 40 fit to half the bar, lit yellow)
params.bad: 0..1 a red plate with an X rises at the -x end of the stick (does not fit)
params.ok: 0..1 a green plate with a check rises at the -x end (fits); hides the red plate
